title: Stay Hydrated
description: Drink at least 8 glasses of water today. Your brain is 75% water!

title: Take a Stretch Break
description: Stand up and stretch for 5 minutes every hour to improve posture.

title: Practice Deep Breathing
description: Take 5 deep breaths to reduce stress and improve focus.

title: Check Your Posture
description: Sit up straight! Good posture prevents back pain and fatigue.

title: Get Moving
description: Take a 10-minute walk to boost your energy and mood.
